filas_sql.abstract: VITAMIN A DEFICIENCY, WHICH IS ESPECIALLY WIDESPREAD AMONG CHILDREN YOUNGER THAN AGE 5 YEARS, IS A MAJOR BARRIER TO REDUCING CHILD MORTALITY RATES IN FRENCH-SPEAKING WEST AFRICA. A LARGE AMOUNT OF AN INDIGENOUS PLANT SOURCE OF PROVITAMIN A CAROTENOIDS ARE LOST TO POSTHARVEST WASTE.
